claims.claim: A child edit to a file represented by a complete parent Write cache entry enters the primary model request as changed-file text; the child final answer need not contain the edit.
limitations: Ordinary Read cache entries have an offset and are skipped; default shared checkout only.

claims.claim: Ordinary parent Read and no prior parent access did not deliver the child edit marker in the retained controls, although the child successfully changed the file.
limitations: The unread control ends at completion; the ordinary Read control additionally advances through a separate file Read.

claims.claim: Child Bash output is present in child API tool results and SDK child messages but absent from primary API requests when the child returns a fixed answer.
limitations: One Bash command, no cwd changes; does not cover all progress forwarding configurations.

claims.claim: Normal background Agent launch receipts supply a path described as the full subagent JSONL transcript; the coordinator control omits that pointer from its model-facing receipt.
limitations: The primary was not directed to read the transcript; the supplied pointer establishes an explicit access path rather than automatic transcript injection.

claims.claim: Agent reporting includes final text plus harness conditions, completion status, token/tool counts and elapsed time; ordinary notifications can contain output paths and worktree metadata.
limitations: Not every conditional note was exercised; mock token counters are not real model usage.

claims.claim: Context creation shares session permission setters, selected registries/callbacks and other session state; synchronous agents share general AppState mutation, while background wrappers propagate only the four named whitelist fields.
limitations: Shared references alone are not proof of automatic model-message delivery; permission/browser/artifact effects were not tested.

claims.claim: Nested instruction propagation has an implementation, but its flag is read from Yn constructed with an empty shape. Setting the same-named environment variable does not create a getter; paired controls keep child nested text out of primary requests.
limitations: Applies to the unmodified shipped typed-environment module; no code injection or internal-build flag registration was attempted.

claims.claim: Subagent context creates a separate read cache, nested-memory trigger array and memory selector; dynamic skills use a different host registry, established in the preceding investigation.
limitations: Conversation isolation does not imply workspace or host state isolation.
